entries.dialogueText: The sound of the falling drops on the Alliance of Nations dome made for an unexpectedly soothing backdrop to what I could tell was going to be a tense session.

entries.dialogueText: I sat with Laurento and the rest of the Rizian delegation in the half-full assembly hall.

entries.dialogueText: Today's session was to focus on South Merkopa only. Looking around the room, I could see representatives and leaders from Wehlen, Morella, Derdia and Lespia.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Alvarez must have given him quite..."
entries.dialogueText: "Alvarez must have given him quite the talking-to."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It must be awkward, encountering o..."
entries.dialogueText: "It must be awkward, encountering one's ex-husband here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wonder how badly the two of them..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wonder how badly the two of them fell out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Look at those two lovebirds.""
entries.dialogueText: "Look at those two lovebirds."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wonder what they were talking ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wonder what they were talking about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did I make a mistake? Should I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did I make a mistake? Should I have gone with the Duke's deal after all?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""They clearly plan to put up a unit..."
entries.dialogueText: "They clearly plan to put up a united front. It'll be hard to argue against them."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Imagine the amount of tension in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Imagine the amount of tension in this room had that been the case."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Reinhart had an obvious scowl on hi..."
entries.dialogueText: Reinhart had an obvious scowl on his face.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Prime Minister Alvarez can't be ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Alvarez can't be happy. The last thing he wants is Rizia and Pales making deals behind his back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waved to Duke Reinhart. He nodded..."
entries.dialogueText: I waved to Duke Reinhart. He nodded tersely in acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He seems nervous. Alvarez's presen..."
entries.dialogueText: "He seems nervous. Alvarez's presence here is rattling him, I think."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I've been told that Lespia renegot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been told that Lespia renegotiated their deal after Rizia backed out. Not in Pales' favor."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Are you well, Your Majesty? Your f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you well, Your Majesty? Your father always had a case of nerves before these sessions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not surprised. One more royal..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not surprised. One more royal duty that he couldn't handle."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm nervous about the arbitration..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm nervous about the arbitration case. We have a lot riding on that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Arcasia or United Contana were..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Arcasia or United Contana were here today, I'd be nervous. All these others are small potatoes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm fine, Mr. Esquibel. I apprecia..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm fine, Mr. Esquibel. I appreciate your concern."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We turned our attention to the fron..."
entries.dialogueText: We turned our attention to the front of the room as President Ephraim Nines entered.

entries.title: Ephraim Nines (R): ""First on today's docket is Prime M..."
entries.dialogueText: "First on today's docket is Prime Minister Alma Saltana of the Republic of Morella."

entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Alma Saltana strode..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Alma Saltana strode up to the podium. She had to lower the microphone to reach it.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Mr. President, esteemed leaders an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, esteemed leaders and distinguished guests."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Big trouble in a small package.""
entries.dialogueText: "Big trouble in a small package."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not find that amusing, Mr. Es..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not find that amusing, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope she keeps her address short..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope she keeps her address short, too."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's hear what she has to say bef..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's hear what she has to say before passing judgement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Morellan leader greeted the ass..."
entries.dialogueText: The Morellan leader greeted the assembly. Her voice had a melodic lilt to it that I associated with Qinal.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It is my honor to speak in these h..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is my honor to speak in these hallowed halls for the first time."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I come before you as a representat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I come before you as a representative of the new Morella. A country committed to breaking free from the shackles of our repressive past."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And one that is proud to build bri..."
entries.dialogueText: "And one that is proud to build bridges with those who share our vision of a more equal society."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She nodded towards the upper seats..."
entries.dialogueText: She nodded towards the upper seats of the assembly room. I looked behind me to see Valgslandian Chancellor Emmerich Hegel applauding fiercely.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Laurento, I thought this was a *So..."
entries.dialogueText: "Laurento, I thought this was a *South* Merkopa session."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who invited him?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who invited him?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew today would be exciting, bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew today would be exciting, but this is another level."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Chancellor Hegel is not on the spe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel is not on the speaking program. He must have flown to Kyrute solely to support Madame Prime Minister."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Prime Minister Saltana must have w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana must have wanted him in the audience to demonstrate Valgsland's support for her country."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Chancellor Hegel isn't on today's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Chancellor Hegel isn't on today's program. But I wouldn't rule out an impromptu speech."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""It is a time of transition for Mor..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a time of transition for Morella. But as we redefine our principles and our partnerships, one fact becomes abundantly clear."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""A country that is now truly aligne..."
entries.dialogueText: "A country that is now truly aligned with the AN values of justice, solidarity and human dignity."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We can no longer abide the sensele..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can no longer abide the senseless exploitation of our land, people and resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Aha. I knew this would be about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aha. I knew this would be about the International Trade Zone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Senseless? Gold makes plenty of se..."
entries.dialogueText: "Senseless? Gold makes plenty of sense to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hegel put this into her head. I'm..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hegel put this into her head. I'm sure of it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""She hasn't taken her eye off the t..."
entries.dialogueText: "She hasn't taken her eye off the topic since her election."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Behind every strong woman is a cra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Behind every strong woman is a crazed Valgslandian socialist."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The agreement her predecessors sig..."
entries.dialogueText: "The agreement her predecessors signed was airtight. She'll need a lot of international backing to get out of it."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""For too long, our so-called 'partn..."
entries.dialogueText: "For too long, our so-called 'partners' in the Meftiem International Trade Zone have dug the ground out from under us."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""We've allowed them to ravage our s..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've allowed them to ravage our soil and abuse our workers, while reaping more than their fair share of the profits."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Meanwhile, the shocking lack of mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, the shocking lack of mining regulations in countries such as Rizia shows they are no less careless at home than abroad."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Meanwhile, countries such as Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: "Meanwhile, countries such as Rizia are willing to regulate their mining industries at home, but turn a blind eye to exploitation abroad."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't turn a blind eye! I just h..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't turn a blind eye! I just haven't gotten around to regulating the MITZ yet."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I have the feeling Ms. Saltana wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have the feeling Ms. Saltana wouldn't be happy either way."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Morella's international profile is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella's international profile isn't large enough to go after a country of Lespia's stature. Yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I knew I shouldn't have given in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I knew I shouldn't have given in to Rusty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If it wasn't this, she'd go after..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it wasn't this, she'd go after us for something else. She's trying to prove a point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why is she naming us? What about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why is she naming us? What about the corruption in Lespian industries?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not our fault that Morellan s..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not our fault that Morellan soil is so prone to cave-ins."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I doubt regulations are the real i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt regulations are the real issue here. If it wasn't this, it would be something else."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""Morella calls on the Alliance of N..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella calls on the Alliance of Nations to recognize our human rights struggle."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""And to accept that if the Meftiem..."
entries.dialogueText: "And to accept that if the Meftiem ITZ is to continue, any wealth it generates must be reinvested in the Morellan people."

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""They send security forces to guard..."
entries.dialogueText: "They send security forces to guard their gold, yet leave the rest of Morella to the mercy of Derdian terrorists."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal stepped..."
entries.dialogueText: Supreme Wiseman Jorga Azmal stepped on to the stage, dressed in a ceremonial robe with silver trim.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There were some whispers from withi..."
entries.dialogueText: There were some whispers from within the room as Wehlen's president stepped up to the podium.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He silenced them with a theatrical..."
entries.dialogueText: He silenced them with a theatrical shushing motion, then continued.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Dear fellow leaders!""
entries.dialogueText: "Dear fellow leaders!"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I wish I could say I was happy to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could say I was happy to be here, standing as one of the six proud nations of South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And yet I feel only sorrow. Sorrow..."
entries.dialogueText: "And yet I feel only sorrow. Sorrow that our magnificent region has let itself been torn apart by forces greater than ourselves."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I speak, of course, of Arcasia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I speak, of course, of Arcasia and Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Convinced of the idea that might m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Convinced of the idea that might makes right, they sow discord among us in order to strengthen themselves."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Conveniently leaving out United Co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Conveniently leaving out United Contana."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wehlen alienates every country aro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen alienates every country around it, then blames the superpowers? What nerve."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He isn't wrong. Our countries coul..."
entries.dialogueText: "He isn't wrong. Our countries could all be allies if we rid ourselves of foreign interference."

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""And Wehlen -- poor, war-torn Wehle..."
entries.dialogueText: "And Wehlen -- poor, war-torn Wehlen -- must pay the highest price."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Who among you can deny ATO's invol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who among you can deny ATO's involvement in the Wehlen Civil War?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Or Rumburg's shipping of arms to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or Rumburg's shipping of arms to the Bludish separatist movement, both during the war and in the present day?"

entries.title: Narrator: "Nobody in the hall said a word. Wik..."
entries.dialogueText: Nobody in the hall said a word. Wiktor looked up at me directly.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Or Rumburg's shipping of arms to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or Rumburg's shipping of arms to the Bludish separatist movement?"

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""In light of that, I cannot simply..."
entries.dialogueText: "In light of that, I cannot simply accept that the Zille bombing -- the most heinous terrorist act to occur in Wehlen since the Civil War -- was the work of a few rogue agents."

entries.dialogueText: "In light of that, the Rizian government's failure to denounce the perpetrators of the Zille bombing -- the most heinous terrorist attack to occur in Wehlen since the Civil War -- concerns me greatly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Here it comes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Here it comes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Suspects have already been named and extradited. But is it a tactic to throw us off track? Rumburg isn't beneath such subterfuge."

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It is to my everlasting regret tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is to my everlasting regret that when Wehlen was at its weakest, our direct neighbors opted for an alliance with a nation that has sought to harm us at every turn."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, it doesn't count if the super..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it doesn't count if the superpower is *his* patron."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Especially since he himself has we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially since he himself has well-documented ties to United Contana."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He can start by getting rid of his..."
entries.dialogueText: "He can start by getting rid of his own ties to United Contana."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I do not blame the great Kingdom o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not blame the great Kingdom of Rizia for its decision. But neither can I ignore that for the past 20 years, Rumburg has maintained a presence to both our north and south."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""This is why I have decided to invo..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is why I have decided to invoke the AN Threat Mitigation Protocol for Treaty Obligations to delay the return of Zille until that risk is neutralized."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Bullshit!""
entries.dialogueText: "Bullshit!"

entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pounded my fist on the table, cre..."
entries.dialogueText: I pounded my fist on the table, creating a racket.

entries.dialogueText: Gasps and murmurs rippled through the assembly. I felt many pairs of eyes on me.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You'll have to wait until your own..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have to wait until your own speech to raise your objections."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I am a man who respects the rule o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am a man who respects the rule of law. Yet I cannot put my country-people at risk by abandoning the territory while these questions still hang in the air."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I sat still and kept listening."
entries.dialogueText: I sat still and kept listening.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento shrugged and joined in."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento shrugged and joined in.

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Especially since the government ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially since the government agencies investigating the incident seem more interested in pinning the blame on Wehlen than uncovering the truth."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Rizia's inaction in the wake of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's inaction in the wake of the incident speaks volumes."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""What is to stop such violence from..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is to stop such violence from reoccurring? What will happen to the Wehzeks who have made Zille their home once Rizia -- and by proxy Rumburg -- regains control of the region?"

entries.dialogueText: From across the room, I saw Patricio Alvarez do the same.

entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""If I may continue...""
entries.dialogueText: "If I may continue..."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""It is not my intention to keep cus..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not my intention to keep custody of the Zille region forever. The sooner that safety and security are restored, the sooner we may begin preparing for an orderly transition."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""I hope for swift cooperation from..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope for swift cooperation from His Majesty King Romus and my fellow South Merkopan nations."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before speaking, he waved his hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Before speaking, he waved his hand in the air six times, representing the six pillars of Golcondism.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm surprised he flew out here. De..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm surprised he flew out here. Derdia's Supreme Wiseman normally refrains from speaking in public."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's too busy praying in a cave?""
entries.dialogueText: "He's too busy praying in a cave?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever he has to say must be imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever he has to say must be important."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He must have been eager to catch a..."
entries.dialogueText: "He must have been eager to catch a glimpse of me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Supreme Wiseman spoke in a deep..."
entries.dialogueText: The Supreme Wiseman spoke in a deep baritone.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Dear great and powerful leaders of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dear great and powerful leaders of South Merkopa. In the name of Prophet Wruhec, I salute you all."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""I am humble enough to know that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am humble enough to know that we men alone cannot decide the fate of a continent. Not without God's guidance."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""And it is God who has guided me he..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it is God who has guided me here today."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""We are one of the few nations brav..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are one of the few nations brave enough to let themselves be ruled by His law. But we are also a country like any other."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Yet our attempts to find common gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet our attempts to find common ground with our neighbors have been rebuffed, over and over, solely on account of our beliefs."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked over at where Alma Saltana..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked over at where Alma Saltana was sitting. She was openly scowling.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The PM of Morella accuses us of vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The PM of Morella accuses us of violating her borders. Yet it was not so long ago that we were one country."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Because of arbitrary lines that ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because of arbitrary lines that have been drawn, my people can no longer visit the graves of their ancestors, or the shrines where they once worshipped."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Every single one of us, Derdia, Mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every single one of us, Derdia, Morella, Rizia, Wehlen -- we all have different views, yet we all are united by the divine path of St. Wruhec."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""And it is my humble request that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "And it is my humble request that we Derdians be able to follow that path as we have for centuries."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hmm. He sounds reasonable enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. He sounds reasonable enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's forgetting the part where Der..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's forgetting the part where Derdians take part in violent insurgencies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's a gross oversimplification...."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a gross oversimplification. His path is not ours."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""He's ignoring the divergence withi..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's ignoring the divergence within Wruhecism, yes. But we do share many of the same holy sites."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, he's far from the servant of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he's far from the servant of peace that he makes himself out to be."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But does what he's saying justify..."
entries.dialogueText: "But does what he's saying justify the violent acts committed by Derdian pilgrims?"

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""On that note. Concerns have been r..."
entries.dialogueText: "On that note. Concerns have been raised about the missile tests my country has been conducting."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""Our aim has only ever been to prot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our aim has only ever been to protect our people and way of life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's true. We should apply the sam..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true. We should apply the same standards in the MITZ as we do in Rizia."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""And we can, if you're willing to f..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we can, if you're willing to fight another uphill battle with Mr. Montoro."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Brava, Madam Prime Minister!""
entries.dialogueText: "Brava, Madam Prime Minister!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Chancellor Hegel was standing now...."
entries.dialogueText: Chancellor Hegel was standing now. The other AN guests turned their heads in his direction.

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""As fellow stewards of the Internat..."
entries.dialogueText: "As fellow stewards of the International Trade Zone and fellow soldiers in the fight against imperialism, the nation of Valgsland supports Morella in its journey."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He must have cut a fat deal with h..."
entries.dialogueText: "He must have cut a fat deal with her."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can't she see that he's using her?""
entries.dialogueText: "Can't she see that he's using her?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you sure that he can't get her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure that he can't get her into the CSP?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The two were meeting more regularl..."
entries.dialogueText: "The two were meeting more regularly in the weeks leading up to this session, it's true."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Not until Morella improves its mil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not until Morella improves its military. Which may be the reason for this sudden interest in nationalization..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It's difficult to tell who's using..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's difficult to tell who's using whom."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hegel sat back down. Nines motioned..."
entries.dialogueText: Hegel sat back down. Nines motioned for Prime Minister Saltana to continue.

entries.speaker: Alma Saltana
entries.title: Alma Saltana: ""I thank all of you for your attent..."
entries.dialogueText: "I thank all of you for your attention today, and look forward to forging a brighter future for the people of South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I didn't say anything."
entries.dialogueText: I didn't say anything.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""This is unprecedented, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is unprecedented, Your Majesty. No nation has invoked this protocol since the signing of the AN Charter nearly a century ago."

entries.speaker: Wiktor Smolak
entries.title: Wiktor Smolak (R): ""Together, we are strong!""
entries.dialogueText: "Together, we are strong!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He raised his arms in expectation o..."
entries.dialogueText: He raised his arms in expectation of applause. None came.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""None of our neighbors is openly ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "None of our neighbors is openly taking Wehlen's side. That bodes well for us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Wiktor shook his head and left the..."
entries.dialogueText: Wiktor shook his head and left the stage.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez was..."
entries.dialogueText: Prime Minister Patricio Alvarez was next. He straightened his tie as he approached the microphone.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""May I just start by voicing my hea..."
entries.dialogueText: "May I just start by voicing my heartfelt support for this fine organization and the role that it plays."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Were it not for the Alliance of Na..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were it not for the Alliance of Nations, there would be no way to stop our countries' petty quarrels from devouring the world."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Which, ladies and gentlemen, is pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which, ladies and gentlemen, is precisely what's in danger of happening today."

entries.dialogueText: "The nation of Lespia is deeply concerned about the deployment of Rizian naval forces around the Aureus gas field in the Antacean Sea."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It is essential that Rizia respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is essential that Rizia respect the legal process and accept the results of arbitration, whatever they may be."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""The use of military force to occup..."
entries.dialogueText: "The use of military force to occupy a disputed territory goes directly against the AN's most cherished principles."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We stand ready to aid in the peace..."
entries.dialogueText: "We stand ready to aid in the peaceful settlement of this dispute, and we beg of the AN not to let Rizia's show of force affect its judgement."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Such blatant use of intimidation t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such blatant use of intimidation tactics shows that the Kingdom has no intention of doing so."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""As a matter of fact, from this poi..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, from this point forward, Wehlen's actions in Zille should be considered an illegal occupation of Rizian territory."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""We consider this nothing less than..."
entries.dialogueText: "We consider this nothing less than a socialist incursion into our beloved value systems."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Rizia has done nothing but abide b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has done nothing but abide by the rule of law, while Wehlen attempts to control that which it does not own."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hear, hear!""
entries.dialogueText: "Hear, hear!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Did you hear that, President Smola..."
entries.dialogueText: "Did you hear that, President Smolak? Illegal!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A round of lukewarm applause came f..."
entries.dialogueText: A round of lukewarm applause came from those assembled.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Hmm. Lespia's support is encouragi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. Lespia's support is encouraging, but we may have to work harder to get other neighbors on our side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I waited for the crowd's reaction."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for the crowd's reaction.
entries.menuText: Say nothing and wait for the crowd's reaction.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""And now I'm afraid I must address..."
entries.dialogueText: "And now I'm afraid I must address yet another threat to Southern Merkopa masterminded by the Malenyevist east."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I speak, of course, of the conspir..."
entries.dialogueText: "I speak, of course, of the conspiracy to nationalize the Meftiem International Trade Zone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Chancellor Hegel stood up again. Al..."
entries.dialogueText: Chancellor Hegel stood up again. Alvarez ignored him.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Let us not for one second believe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us not for one second believe that Morella is acting of its own accord. The long arm of the Contanan Security Pact is behind this."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""By giving in to Prime Minister Sal..."
entries.dialogueText: "By giving in to Prime Minister Saltana's demands, the nations of Lespia and Rizia would be effectively paying to increase United Contana's sphere of influence."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I know I am not alone in wanting t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know I am not alone in wanting to avoid those disastrous consequences."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Before arbitration concludes, we w..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""No need to shout, Your Majesty. Th..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to shout, Your Majesty. The AN will see through--."

entries.speaker: Emmerich Hegel
entries.title: Emmerich Hegel (R): ""Forgive my ill-timed cough. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive my ill-timed cough. I have a terrible cold today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you, Mr. Chancellor.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mr. Chancellor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I heard what you said, Mr. Hegel,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I heard what you said, Mr. Hegel, but I don't require your support."

entries.dialogueText: I said nothing. Hegel gave me a significant look, then sat back in his chair.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a significant look, then..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a significant look, then sat back in his chair.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez

entries.dialogueText: "Ahem. That brings me to another point I was going to make today..."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Any attempt to seize the Internati..."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""That will be all.""

entries.dialogueText: "That isn't funny. It's scary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's right, you know. Humans made..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's right, you know. Humans made these weapons, but only God can guide us to use them the right way."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Then I hope He guides the Supreme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I hope He guides the Supreme Wiseman in the right direction."

entries.dialogueText: "What's scary is if he finds the wrong buyer for this technology."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""All in the Golcondist gospel, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "All in the Golcondist gospel, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Azmal put his hands on the podium."
entries.dialogueText: Azmal put his hands on the podium.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""How far we have fallen, that the o..."
entries.dialogueText: "How far we have fallen, that the only country in South Merkopa where the pillars of Nurity still stand tall is treated as a laughing stock."

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""You all speak of superpowers. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "You all speak of superpowers. But I know there is only one superpower we need to worry about."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pointed upwards."
entries.dialogueText: He pointed upwards.

entries.speaker: Jorga Azmal
entries.title: Jorga Azmal: ""The sooner our nations come togeth..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sooner our nations come together under Him, the sooner true peace and prosperity can be realized."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My monarchical forebears instilled..."
entries.dialogueText: "My monarchical forebears instilled in me a great respect for this institution and its values."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've heard enough today about ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've heard enough today about how important the Alliance of Nations is. So I will get straight to the point."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which is why I am so saddened by t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I am so saddened by the division plaguing South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As we have seen over and over thro..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we have seen over and over throughout history, our nations can accomplish much more together than we can apart."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN's unwavering commitment to..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN's unwavering commitment to peace and justice in times of tension is a true inspiration."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you all see Wehlen's failur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you all see Wehlen's failure to return Zille for what it is: a flagrant violation of international law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN Threat Mitigation Protocol..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN Threat Mitigation Protocol can only be invoked under extreme circumstances. In my opinion, the Zille incident is not one of them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But such bonds do not always form..."
entries.dialogueText: "But such bonds do not always form organically, Sometimes they must be fostered, other times forced."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Any intelligent person can see thr..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The bombing was a tragedy. However..."
entries.dialogueText: "The bombing was a tragedy. However, my kingdom has taken the necessary steps to ensure it will not be repeated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate Prime Minister Alvare..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The AN's swift interference has st..."
entries.dialogueText: "The AN's swift interference has stopped many a would-be evildoer in their tracks."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Which is why I am appealing to you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Which is why I am appealing to you all today."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A lesson which all of you have app..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lesson which all of you have apparently forgotten."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And as the world becomes more cutt..."
entries.dialogueText: "And as the world becomes more cutthroat, its existence becomes all the more essential."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am aware that the comments made..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am aware that the comments made by President Wiktor Smolak earlier in this session demand a response from me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The people of Zille yearn for thei..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people of Zille yearn for their home. Who is Wehlen to deny it to them?"

entries.dialogueText: "But now I ask of you: Who will be next?"

entries.dialogueText: "Supreme Wiseman Azmal, Wehlen's occupation of Zille represents an invasion of Dastnurity into the land of St. Wruhec. Derdia must not condone it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Duke Reinhart, given the Grand Duc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duke Reinhart, given the Grand Duchy's close ties to Lespia, I would think you'd align with Mr. Alvarez on this vital issue."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Alma Saltana applauded somewhat hes..."
entries.dialogueText: Alma Saltana applauded somewhat hesitantly.

entries.dialogueText: Jorga Azmal applauded loudly. His face remained impassive.

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you. That's all I wanted to hear."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Like me, he knows there is more at..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like me, he knows there is more at stake than a mere sliver of Rizia. We are fighting for the future of South Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do not ask for your commitment a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not ask for your commitment at this time. Only that you will support Rizia when the moment arrives."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If President Smolak does not honor..."
entries.dialogueText: "If President Smolak does not honor the terms of our agreement, we will be forced to take matters into our own hands."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prior to the civil war, Rizia and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prior to the civil war, Rizia and Wehlen were close allies. I believe we can return to that relationship."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia and Wehlen may never be alli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia and Wehlen may never be allies as we once were. But I am holding out hope for a peaceful coexistence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""At this moment, our alliance with..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this moment, our alliance with Rumburg comes secondary to our relationship with our direct neighbors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wehlen has been unfairly maligned..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wehlen has been unfairly maligned since the events of the civil war. After order is restored in Zille, we shall help it regain its international prominence."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Given the ongoing exploitation hap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given the ongoing exploitation happening in Morella, I am not surprised that Prime Minister Saltana has looked to the east for assistance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will discuss this further at the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will discuss this further at the next meeting of the MITZ board."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The pillaging of the Meftiem Inter..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pillaging of the Meftiem International Trade Zone must stop. On that, we are in agreement."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The specter of encroaching sociali..."
entries.dialogueText: "The specter of encroaching socialism does not scare me as much as the potential loss of our precious resources."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let us not forget that the gas fie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us not forget that the gas field would not have been discovered without our scientists' initiative."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a signee of the AN Directive on..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a signee of the AN Directive on Offshore Resources, we have a right to the undersea gas within 200 kilometers from our coast. No matter which coast."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia still maintains ancient sove..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia still maintains ancient sovereignty over Pales. Ipso facto, their resources are ours as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As Morella's longtime allies, we a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As Morella's longtime allies, we are prepared to offer what assistance we can in building a more equitable MITZ."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yet Rizia cannot condone this new..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet Rizia cannot condone this new radical direction. Nor will we simply accept the massive job and revenue loss that would come with nationalization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia cannot condone this radical..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia cannot condone this radical new direction, nor will we simply accept the massive job and revenue loss that would come with nationalization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Morella is free to choose its own..."
entries.dialogueText: "Morella is free to choose its own political direction. But it cannot use those politics to wantonly lay waste to its neighbors' economies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will use this forum to warn Prim..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will use this forum to warn Prime Minister Saltana that if she is looking for a fight, Lespia and Rizia will give her one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Prime Minister Saltana is not acti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Prime Minister Saltana is not acting of her own agency. The Malenyevist east is coercing our neighbor to do its bidding."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I suspect her real interest is..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I suspect her real interest is not in building a more equitable ITZ. It's in acquiring enough wealth to join the Contanan Security Pact."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But Madam Prime Minister clearly h..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Madam Prime Minister clearly has her heart set on a hostile takeover, with Valgsland's aid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
